entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State.

This is an appeal under section 14-A of S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, 1989 in connection with T.R. Case No.15 of 2023 arising out of Umerkote P.S. Case No.121 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Umerkote, Nabarangpur for offence punishable under section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Umerkote, Nabarangpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The appellant moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge,
Umerkote which was rejected on 21.06.2023.

Considering the submission made by the learned // 2 // counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in judicial custody since 07.06.2023 and he has been charge sheeted under section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code and after going through the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim, who is aged about twenty one years placed by the learned counsel for the State and also the medical examination report of the victim, which is annexed to the application as Annexure-4, I am inclined to release the Isrium Sundarmani vs State Of Odisha And on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172039928/
1 appellant on bail.

entities.text: Isrium Sundarmani vs State Of Odisha And on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Let the appellant be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper subject to conditions that the appellant shall appear before the learned trial Court on each date when the case would be posted for trial and he shall not try to tamper with the evidence or try to come in contact with the victim.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
The CRLA is accordingly disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( S.K. Sahoo) Signed by: RABINDRA KUMAR MISHRA

Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA,
CUTTACK Date: 22-Sep-2023 12:58:13
